head.t: Arthrex strengthens commitment to joint preservation through partnership with ICRS
head.x: Arthrex, a global leader in minimally invasive surgical technology, announced a partnership with the International Cartilage Regeneration & Joint Preservation Society (ICRS), building on a long-standing collaboration and strengthening efforts to advance cartilage restoration and joint preservation worldwide.
